_help: One entry per photo folder. 'folder' is the name inside photos/. 'years' shows on the homepage. 'note' is optional text shown at the top of that place's page - leave it empty if you have nothing to say. 'cover' is optional; it is the file name (inside the folder) used as the homepage picture. If blank, the first photo is used. 'favorites' is an optional list of file names; if any are listed anywhere, the big photo at the top of the homepage is picked only from favorites. 'oldPage' is the old page name, kept so old links still work. A place visited more than once gets one entry per trip (same 'name', its own folder and year).

places.name: Spain
places.note: Taken while vacationing in 2026 with good friends. We traveled from Lisbon, Portugal, to Barcelona, Spain, visiting many places in between.
